nodes.label: Merge of the CLI skeleton (#1), samples/ folder, JSON Schema (#2) and kg validate (#3)
nodes.description:
Goal: verify and merge PR #13 (issue #1), document samples/ for manual tests on third-party repos, then implement issue #2 (JSON Schema) and issue #3 (kg validate).
Instructions: user asked for a manual test plan for #1/PR #13, wanted samples/ documented separately, approved commits, pushes and PR creation step by step; PRs opened via the GitHub REST API with the token from .env.
Discoveries: the author cannot approve own PRs on GitHub, so the user merges directly; argparse usage errors are in English, set command=null in the JSON envelope and stubs exit 3; tests for #3 found two real bugs (suggesting 'file:file:' for ID 'file:', duplicated errors when several required fields are missing).
Accomplished: PR #13 merged (closes #1); PR #14 merged (samples/, Refs #12); PR #15 merged (JSON Schema + kg schema, closes #2, 60 tests); kg validate implemented on feat/3-kg-validate, commit c6efcf1, PR #16 opened (104 tests); worktree ../networkx-feat-2 removed.
Next steps: user merges PR #16; then issue #4 (kg init and the .kg/ store), base for #5 and #6; optionally delete merged local branches feat/1-cli-base, feat/2-json-schema, docs/12-samples (awaiting user).
Relevant files: src/kg/schema/kg.schema.json, src/kg/schema/__init__.py, src/kg/schema/validation.py, src/kg/cli.py, docs/esquema.md, examples/minimo.json, examples/repo-basico.json, samples/README.md, .gitignore, tests/test_schema.py, tests/test_validation.py.

nodes.label: Issue #1: kg package and base CLI (merged via PR #13)
nodes.description:
What: package renamed to kg, argparse CLI with stub subcommands, --json/--kg-dir global options; PR #13 merged into main (merge commit 30096fe), issue #1 closed.
Why: base for every other MVP issue.
Where: src/kg/cli.py, src/kg/__main__.py, pyproject.toml, tests/test_cli.py.
Learned: merged with a merge commit, not squash; the user could not approve the PR because they are its author.

nodes.label: Issue #2: JSON Schema with the standard catalog (merged via PR #15)
nodes.description:
What: JSON Schema draft 2020-12 for the input format (version, nodes, edges, attrs, provenance) with 16 standard entity types and 11 relation types, kg schema subcommand (--path, --json), helpers load_schema/schema_path/validator/find_custom_types, examples and docs; commit a22a3e2, PR #15 merged, issue #2 closed.
Why: RF-01 (official schema readable by agents) and RF-02 (standard catalog plus custom types that warn).
Where: src/kg/schema/kg.schema.json, src/kg/schema/__init__.py, docs/esquema.md, examples/, tests/test_schema.py.
Learned: catalogs are read from the JSON itself; ID-prefix vs type consistency, dangling edges and duplicate IDs were deliberately left to kg validate (#3).

nodes.label: Use the jsonschema library (>=4.18) with draft 2020-12
nodes.description:
What: new runtime dependency jsonschema>=4.18, justified in pyproject.toml; the schema ships as package-data.
Why: draft 2020-12 validation with JSON error paths, needed for the actionable messages of kg validate (RF-04).
Where: pyproject.toml, src/kg/schema/.
Learned: the schema $id is a URL used only as an identifier; that path does not exist on GitHub.

nodes.label: Nodes and edges reject extra fields; custom data goes in attrs
nodes.description:
What: additionalProperties false on nodes and edges; anything project-specific lives under attrs.
Why: catches agent typos (e.g. 'lable') instead of silently storing them.
Where: src/kg/schema/kg.schema.json.
Learned: flagged to the user as a decision to review in PR #15; it was merged as is.

nodes.label: Provenance: method, extractor and confidence required; timestamp optional
nodes.description:
What: provenance requires method, extractor and confidence; source, lines and timestamp are optional.
Why: a mandatory timestamp would break byte-for-byte determinism of the store (RNF-08).
Where: src/kg/schema/kg.schema.json, docs/esquema.md.
Learned: extractors should avoid writing timestamps if output must be reproducible.

nodes.label: Custom types are valid but warned: PascalCase entities, snake_case relations
nodes.description:
What: types outside the standard catalog pass the schema if they follow PascalCase (nodes) or snake_case (edges); find_custom_types returns their JSON path so kg validate emits a warning.
Why: RF-02 hybrid schema (standard catalog plus free types).
Where: src/kg/schema/__init__.py, src/kg/schema/validation.py.
Learned: examples/repo-basico.json includes a custom type on purpose and validates with 2 warnings.

nodes.label: kg validate reports every problem in one pass with path, got, expected and a suggestion
nodes.description:
What: each error carries JSON path, received value, expected value and a concrete suggestion (typo fixes, standard type casing, missing ID prefix, nearest existing node ID); whole-file checks for duplicate IDs (pointing to the first) and dangling edges; custom types and ID-prefix/type mismatch are warnings; exit 0 valid (even with warnings), 1 errors incl. malformed JSON or non-UTF-8, 2 file missing/unreadable; stdin via 'kg validate -'; never touches the store.
Why: an agent must be able to fix everything in one iteration (MVP criterion 3, RF-03/04/05, RNF-07).
Where: src/kg/schema/validation.py, src/kg/cli.py, docs/esquema.md (Validation section), tests/test_validation.py.
Learned: jsonschema emits one error per missing required field, so messages must be deduplicated; prefix suggestions must not double the prefix ('file:' -> 'file:file:' bug).

nodes.label: Issue #3: kg validate (PR #16 awaiting merge)
nodes.description:
What: kg validate implemented on branch feat/3-kg-validate, commit c6efcf1, PR #16 opened to main; 104 tests, ruff check and format pass.
Why: next MVP issue after #2; #5 (kg add) depends on it.
Where: src/kg/schema/validation.py, src/kg/cli.py, tests/test_validation.py, tests/test_cli.py, docs/esquema.md.
Learned: waiting for the user to merge PR #16.

nodes.label: Issue #4: kg init and the .kg/ store with deterministic JSON (next)
nodes.description:
What: next MVP issue once PR #16 is merged: kg init creating .kg/, load/save between JSON and nx.MultiDiGraph with deterministic ordering, documented store format.
Why: base for kg add (#5) and kg extract (#6).
Where: GitHub issue #4, area store.
Learned: open choice in the issue between a single graph.json and nodes.json + edges.json, thinking of readable PR diffs.

nodes.label: samples/ holds third-party repos cloned for manual tests, ignored by git except its README
nodes.description:
What: .gitignore ignores samples/* except samples/README.md, which lists test repos (alfredodeza/basic-python-cli) and usage commands; row added to AGENTS.md.
Why: a standard unversioned place to try kg on real repos for MVP criterion 1 (3 repos) and RNF-06 timings.
Where: .gitignore, samples/README.md, AGENTS.md (PR #14, commit 197cb36).
Learned: kept out of PR #13 (one logical change per PR); it only references issue #12, which stays open until the MVP validation is done.

nodes.label: CLI quirks noticed in PR #13 review: English argparse messages, command=null, stubs exit 3
nodes.description:
What: argparse usage errors come out in English while kg's own messages were in Spanish; usage errors set "command": null in the JSON envelope even when the subcommand is recognized (kg --json render); unimplemented stubs exit 3 (internal) rather than 2.
Why: raised as points to confirm before merging #13; none breaks anything.
Where: src/kg/cli.py.
Learned: PR #13 was merged without addressing them; still open to revisit.

nodes.label: GitHub does not let the user approve their own PRs; they merge directly
nodes.description:
What: PRs are authored under the user's account, so review approval is impossible; the user merges directly (branch protection does not require review).
Why: GitHub rule for PR authors.
Where: GitHub repo Cristian1A/kg.
Learned: do not wait for or ask about an approval step; open the PR and let the user merge.

nodes.label: Delete merged local branches feat/1-cli-base, feat/2-json-schema, docs/12-samples
nodes.description:
What: branches already merged into main were kept.
Why: deletions need the user's confirmation, which was not given.
Where: local git repo.
Learned: command offered: git branch -d feat/2-json-schema docs/12-samples feat/1-cli-base.
